children: Grayscale Hyperliquid Staking ETF entered into an amendment to the BitGo custodial services agreement on Sep 30, 2026, adding the Trust as a party. BitGo Trust will custody and safeguard a portion of the Trust’s HYPE, while Anchorage Digital remains the primary custodian. The Sponsor will determine allocations between custodians over time. The addition supports the Trust’s risk management as assets scale.
: Enhance risk management and diversify custody
